name: Crime Stories
description: Chief inspector Constance Forest and her team match wits with petty criminals of all kinds in the fog-shrouded North Shore of Montreal.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In the muddy field of a dairy farm at dawn, a man and a woman lie on the ground, dead. The woman who was preparing a "surprise" in the Laurentians sadly found herself a victim of this tragedy. Constance Forest, Chief Investigator of the Mascouche Regional Bureau believes that there is another victim to be discovered, a Nancy Lebeau-Pratt. Who is responsible for this slaughter?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: An explosion in Joël Savard's trailer! Another victim of Chose-Pet. Important witnesses are added to the list.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Constance and her team are now leading three investigations: a triple murder, Sylvain's attempted murder and the trailer explosion. The list of suspects is only getting longer! Constance has good reason to believe that Marlène, Mike Pratt's accountant and mistress, is implicated in her lover's shenanigans.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Constance sowed doubt in Mike Pratt's head during his interrogation. Did Marlène order Nancy's murder behind her lover's back? Rodrige Rancourt's disappearance remains a mystery for the squad.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The police identify the suspects in Sylvain's attempted murder, brothers Mathieu and Dwayne Henri. Frédérik interrogates one of them to try and unmask who ordered the botched assassination.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Frédérik interrogates Sylvain, showing him the suspicious video under Constance's troubled watch. The police are convinced that there was a dead body in the truck and Frédérik is certain that the body is Rodrigue Rancourt since he was the one who ordered Sylvain's murder.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The American police lose Yvan-Gilles and Joël Savard's trail. Mike is still a prisoner in Éric Charbonneau's basement. Will he make it out alive? Constance and Jonas go to the office of Pratt's Doors and Windows to question Marlène. She seems very worried and upset by Mike's disappearance, but Constance is wary of biker Éric Charbonneau's sister… Rodrigue Rancourt's unsolved disappearance still hangs over the squad.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Frédérik Bérubé has wanted to meet Anne Dupuis since he found out she was the one who parked Rodrigue's car at the casino. Constance panics. With this new information, there are more chances that Sylvain is somehow implicated in Rodrigue Rancourt's murder. She removes herself from the investigation and concentrates on Jonas' new person of interest who holds important information.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The American police confirm that Yvan-Gilles gave accurate information to the Mascouche team: they found Joël Savard's body! As American investigators gather solid evidence against Éric Charbonneau, Frédérik and Constance have to keep an eye on him. Uncle Savard offers to tell Constance and Jonas everything he knows in exchange for money.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Rancourt's body was found on Anne Dupuis' property. Constance, Frédérik Bérubé, Jonas and Antoine must arrest Anne Dupuis and Mike Pratt, since they found bits of Rancourt's body in Mike's car. But Constance has a hard time believing that Mike is mixed up in this. She thinks it's more like a set-up.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A masked shooter bursts into the Caffè Firenze, one of the rallying places of the Italian mafia in the northern crown.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Paulo and Francine desperately search for the body of Maurice Lauzon, thinking that it was Paulo who fired the fatal blow.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The investigation of the possible settlement of accounts between the Italian mafia and the Lauzons degenerates.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Constance and Jonas lose the opportunity to resolve the thefts at the campsite and the disappearance of Maurice Lauzon.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When examining Maurice Lauzon's caravan, Jonas and P. Pineau discover two .22 caliber bullets and traces of blood. Maurice has not just disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After their last visit to the naturist campsite, Constance and Jonas begin to suspect Paulo and Francine for the death of Maurice Lauzon.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The search organized by Sylvain to find his father is postponed due to the absence of the dog handler. Constance and Jonas take the opportunity to question Paulo and Francine.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Eddy Bazin goes to the police. Will he admit the entire plan behind the assassination of Stephano Cozzolino?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The morning when the police were preparing to arrest Paulo and Francine, the owners of the campsite disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Mascouche's squad is stunned: Maurice Lauzon was not murdered with Paulo's weapon. Curiously, The Orsini brothers move to the top of the list of suspects. The noose tightens around Rachelle.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The body of Benoit Charron, a ufology enthusiast, is found in a crop circle on a turkey farm. His wife Kathleen is convinced that aliens abducted her husband.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A feather from a duvet is found at the site of the murders. Antoine questions Kathleen at the station.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Constance and Antoine question Piquette at the Spark Bar, and discover that Laveau is indeed in Mascouche: he becomes an important witness.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Piquette identifies the picture of Marc Laveau at the police station, and tells Antoine about the strange bond between Laveau and Kevin Fontaine.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: DNA from a tissue found in a car, used in a hit and run, doesn’t match Laveau's. Upon interrogation, Océanne who was a lure for the sextortionists, reveals who one of her victims was.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Now that Marc Laveau is no longer in his way, Kevin Fontaine fakes his own kidnapping to get out of this whole mess.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Mascouche squad is investigating a shooting that took place at a window tinting business. Albert Scott Ducharme, a reserved radio host, becomes the police’s number one suspect in the murders.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The detectives examine the scene of Hermano, the mariachi's murder, and call in the anti-gang squad. Jovette shows Constance and Jonas the surveillance footage from the event.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jonas and Antoine question Dany Lafleur about his garage's employees to get the name of their prime suspect.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Mascouche team searches Pedro Mendoza's place, and Antoine finds bloody clothing in the garbage.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Albert and Françoise agree to describe the same version of events to the detectives. Their interrogations go around in circles.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A search is conducted at Linda Portelance's warehouse. Yvan-Gilles contacts Constance to tell her something that becomes a major breakthrough in the investigation.
